notes.title: Updated Controls! 1.0.7
notes.content:
So I've been getting feedback about the controls and have changed them for player 1 and swapped Player 1 and Player 2 keysets to match positions on the keyboard.
[list]
[*]The new controls are WASD for movement, and VBN for weapons.
[*]Enter and Escape should work as start keys in the game now.
[*]Added a bunch of UI elements to make things more clear
[/list]
Unfortunately adding custom keybindings is outside of my control at the moment but I will keep looking into it.

Have fun playing,
Thomas

notes.title: Astral Gun always running issue
notes.content:
If Astral Gun will not stop running for you, try going to task manager and ending the process adb.exe.

Restarting your computer should also fix the issue.

Best,
Thomas
